study_identification_part.si_4_title: Structural brain abnormalities and aggressive behaviour in schizophrenia: Mega-analysis of data from 2095 patients and 2861 healthy controls via the ENIGMA consortium

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Warped Bayesian linear regression was used for normative modeling, implemented via the Predictive Clinical Neuroscience (PCN) toolkit v0.25. The normative models were derived in healthy controls and then applied to patients to calculate individual-level deviations (z-scores) from normative values.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: For every IDP, we derived a normative model in the healthy controls using warped Bayesian linear regression with site, sex, age and -for local IDPs only -a global IDP as predictors. ... Normative modelling was performed with the Predictive Clinical Neuroscience toolkit v0.25.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Multiple imaging-derived phenotypes (IDPs) were modeled: (1) Grey matter: cortical volume (CV) calculated from cortical thickness × surface area, cortical thickness (CT), surface area (SA), and subcortical volumes (SubV) for 8 cortical regions (OFC, DLPFC, ACC, PCC, insula, STG, precuneus, IPL) and 4 subcortical regions (hippocampus, amygdala, striatum, thalamus); (2) White matter: fractional anisotropy (FA) and mean diffusivity (MD) for 14 WM tracts. Global measures included total cortical volume (TCV), global CT, global SA, global FA, and global MD.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: We included all available global imaging-derived phenotypes (IPDs). In addition, we created a measure of total GM volume. ... Cortical volumes were obtained by multiplying average CT by SA. ... we chose an exploratory approach ... This yielded 14 WM tracts: corpus callosum, cingulum, fronto-occipital fasciculus, superior longitudinal fasciculus, sagittal stratum, uncinate fasciculus, corona radiata, internal capsule (IC), external capsule, corticospinal tract, posterior thalamic radiations, fornix and stria terminalis.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: The normative models used site, sex, and age as predictors for all IDPs. For local (regional) IDPs, a global IDP was also included as a predictor (e.g., average CT for local CT measures, total SA for local SA, average FA for local FA, average MD for local MD, total cortical volume for cortical GM regions, and total GM volume for subcortical regions).
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: For every IDP, we derived a normative model in the healthy controls using warped Bayesian linear regression with site, sex, age and -for local IDPs only -a global IDP as predictors. The predictors were selected for statistical (site) or theoretical (sex, age and global IDPs) reasons.
